intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat with your partner as the sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and uninterrupted panoramic views of the sky turning shades of gold and pink. Many resorts offer this as a private excursion, making it an iconic romantic honeymoon memory.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most famous and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, sea turtles, and colorful soft corals. Banana Reef is ideal for snorkelers of all levels and offers crystal-clear visibility up to 30 meters. Guided snorkel tours ensure you spot the best marine life while learning about reef conservation.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa session at a glass-walled underwater treatment room, where you can watch reef fish glide past while receiving traditional Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local botanicals. This ultra-luxurious experience blends wellness with the magic of the ocean, perfect for honeymooners seeking something truly extraordinary.
experiences.location: Huvafen Fushi Resort, North Malé Atoll

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon, where a personal chef sets up a gourmet candlelit lunch or dinner just for two. Feast on freshly grilled lobster, sashimi-grade tuna, and tropical desserts while surrounded by nothing but ocean and sky — the ultimate luxury romantic dining experience.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited island of Maafushi or Hulhumalé to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, browse handmade lacquerwork crafts, and join a hands-on cooking class to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and garudhiya fish soup. A meaningful cultural contrast to resort luxury.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited island of Maafushi or Hulhumalé to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, browse handmade lacquerwork crafts, and join a hands-on cooking class to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and garudhiya fish soup. A meaningful cultural contrast to resort luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage. Arrange budget speedboat or public ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and explore the resort grounds and beachfront. Take a relaxing walk along the beach and get oriented with nearby facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beachfront. Stroll along the shore and enjoy the warm tropical breeze. Visit the resort's beach bar for a welcome mocktail or local juice.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the plane
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport — try a local short-eat snack shop for hedhikaa (Maldivian snacks) around MVR 30–50
meals.dinner: Dine at a local guesthouse restaurant near the resort — try mas riha (fish curry) with roshi (flatbread) for approximately MVR 80–120 per person

day_by_day.notes: Book your speedboat or public ferry transfer in advance to save costs. Public ferries are significantly cheaper than private speedboats. Exchange some currency to Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) at the airport for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session directly from the resort's beachfront house reef. Rent basic snorkeling gear from the resort or a nearby local shop (budget tip: compare prices). Explore the vibrant coral gardens and spot tropical fish, sea turtles, and reef sharks in the calm morning waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion to a nearby sandbank or coral reef. Many local guesthouses and dive shops offer shared group trips for MVR 200–350 per person. Enjoy the crystal-clear lagoon and pristine white sandbar for photos and relaxation.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and rinse off. Head to the local island's main street for a casual evening walk. Visit a local tea shop (sai hotel) for traditional Maldivian tea and short eats — an authentic and very affordable experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local bakery — try mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi, a classic Maldivian breakfast for MVR 40–70
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic lunch from a local shop to enjoy at the sandbank — fresh fruit, water, and snacks for MVR 50–80
meals.dinner: Local restaurant dinner — grilled fish with rice and curry for MVR 80–130 per person

day_by_day.notes: The house reef snorkeling is free or very low cost — one of the best budget activities in the Maldives. Apply reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem. Bring an underwater camera or a waterproof phone case for photos.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — Visit the inhabited island of Maafushi or Hulhumalé to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Explore local homes, mosques, and traditional boat-building workshops. Learn about the island's history and way of life from local guides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cooking class portion of the cultural experience. Learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (tuna broth soup), mas riha (fish curry), and bondibai (rice pudding). Enjoy the meal you prepared together with the local family hosting the class.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon ferry or speedboat. Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner under the stars. Set up a simple picnic blanket on the beach with candles and local food for a budget-friendly romantic evening.

meals.breakfast: Local café breakfast — roshi with eggs and tea for MVR 50–80
meals.lunch: Included in the cooking class experience — enjoy the traditional Maldivian meal you prepared
meals.dinner: Beachside local restaurant — seafood platter with grilled lobster or fish (seasonal pricing) for MVR 150–250 per person

day_by_day.notes: Book the cultural village tour and cooking class in advance through local tour operators for the best budget rates — group tours are more affordable. This is a wonderful experience for couples and honeymooners to connect with local culture together.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga or meditation on the beach — many budget guesthouses offer free or low-cost sessions for guests. Enjoy the peaceful early morning atmosphere with the sound of gentle waves. Alternatively, take a quiet romantic morning walk along the shoreline collecting shells.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a bicycle from the resort or a local shop (MVR 50–100 per day) and explore the local island at your own pace. Visit the local market, Friday mosque, and community areas. Stop at a local juice bar for fresh coconut water straight from the coconut.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's beach area for a DIY romantic sunset experience. Purchase some local snacks, fresh fruit, and drinks from the local shop and create your own sunset picnic on the beach. Watch the sky turn shades of orange and pink over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Mas huni and roshi at the resort or local café for MVR 50–80
meals.lunch: Local short-eat shop — hedhikaa snacks, samosas, and tea for MVR 40–60
meals.dinner: Cook a simple meal using ingredients from the local market, or dine at an affordable local restaurant — tuna pasta or fried rice for MVR 70–100

day_by_day.notes: Bicycle rental is one of the most budget-friendly and enjoyable ways to explore a local Maldivian island. Most local islands are small enough to cycle around in under an hour. Dress modestly when visiting inhabited island areas out of respect for local customs.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget dolphin watching cruise departing early morning — shared group tours cost approximately MVR 250–400 per person. Spot spinner dolphins and sometimes even whale sharks in the open ocean. Bring a camera for incredible wildlife photography opportunities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at a pristine uninhabited sandbank during the dolphin cruise for swimming and snorkeling. Many group tours include this as part of the package. Enjoy the surreal experience of standing on a tiny white sand island surrounded by turquoise water.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxing evening. Visit the resort's common area or beach bar. Treat yourselves to a budget-friendly couples' massage — ask local guesthouses for affordable spa packages (MVR 300–500 per person for a 60-minute massage).

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the cruise — local bread, jam, and tea for MVR 30–50
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the boat or sandbank — sandwiches and fruit prepared the night before
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly for a romantic Friday night dinner — grilled seafood at a beachside restaurant for MVR 200–300 per person

day_by_day.notes: Friday is the holy day in the Maldives — some local shops and services may have reduced hours. Book the dolphin watching tour through a local operator rather than the resort for significantly lower prices. Bring motion sickness tablets if you are sensitive to boat movement.

day_by_day.morning: Beginner scuba diving introduction or Discover Scuba Diving session — many local dive shops offer budget intro dives for MVR 500–800 per person including all equipment. Experience the underwater world at greater depths than snorkeling allows and see larger marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax and recover from the morning dive. Spend the afternoon lounging on the beachfront, reading, and enjoying the resort's beach amenities. Take a refreshing swim in the lagoon and practice snorkeling techniques learned from previous days.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a local Bodu Beru (traditional Maldivian drumming and dance) performance if available on the island — often free or very low cost at local community events. Experience the vibrant rhythm and energy of this ancient cultural tradition.

meals.breakfast: Hearty breakfast before diving — eggs, toast, and juice at the resort café for MVR 70–100
meals.lunch: Light post-dive meal — fresh fruit smoothie and a sandwich from a local café for MVR 60–90
meals.dinner: Local restaurant dinner — chicken curry or vegetable curry with rice for MVR 80–120

day_by_day.notes: Do not eat a heavy meal immediately before scuba diving. Wait at least 2 hours after diving before flying. If you are already certified divers, shop around for the best fun dive packages — group rates offer significant savings. Bodu Beru performances are a truly authentic cultural experience not to be missed.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to a nearby uninhabited island — arrange through a local budget tour operator for MVR 300–500 per person including boat transfer. Enjoy complete privacy on a deserted island — perfect for honeymooners seeking a romantic escape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon snorkeling around the uninhabited island's reef, building sandcastles, swimming, and simply soaking up the paradise atmosphere. Collect shells, photograph the stunning scenery, and enjoy the peace and quiet of having a beach almost entirely to yourselves.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a quiet romantic evening on your beachfront accommodation's private area. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean — the Maldives offers some of the clearest night skies in the world due to minimal light pollution.

meals.breakfast: Resort or local café breakfast — mas huni with roshi and fresh coconut for MVR 60–90
meals.lunch: Packed picnic lunch taken to the uninhabited island — sandwiches, fruit, snacks, and plenty of water
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner for two at a local beachside restaurant — fresh grilled fish catch of the day with local sides for MVR 180–250 per person

day_by_day.notes: This is the midpoint of your trip — a perfect day to relax and celebrate being halfway through your Maldives adventure. Bring plenty of water, sunscreen, and snacks to the uninhabited island as there are no facilities. This experience rivals expensive resort excursions at a fraction of the cost.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling at a different reef spot — ask local dive shops for recommendations on the best nearby snorkeling locations not covered yet. Try to spot manta rays, eagle rays, or nurse sharks which are common in Maldivian waters in March.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the local island's fish market in the afternoon when fishing boats return with the day's catch. Watch the fascinating and lively fish auction process — a very authentic Maldivian experience. Purchase fresh fish directly from fishermen at very low prices if you have cooking facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free or low-cost island event or simply enjoy a leisurely evening walk along the beach. Practice stargazing from the beach — download a star map app to identify constellations visible from the Southern Hemisphere. Share a romantic moment under the Milky Way.

meals.breakfast: Local bakery breakfast — fresh bread, butter, and tea for MVR 40–60
meals.lunch: Fish market area local restaurant — ultra-fresh fish curry with rice for MVR 70–100
meals.dinner: Cook fresh fish purchased from the market (if facilities available) or dine at a local restaurant for MVR 80–130

day_by_day.notes: March is an excellent time for manta ray sightings in the Maldives — ask local dive operators about the best spots. The fish market experience is completely free and offers incredible insight into local Maldivian life. Haggling politely at the fish market is acceptable and expected.

day_by_day.morning: Kayaking adventure — rent kayaks from the resort or a local water sports shop (MVR 100–150 per hour) and paddle around the lagoon. Explore the coastline, spot marine life through the crystal-clear water, and enjoy the physical activity in paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local school or community center if open to visitors — many Maldivian islands welcome respectful visitors and it provides a wonderful window into daily island life. Alternatively, spend the afternoon at the beach practicing underwater photography with your waterproof camera.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni (traditional Maldivian boat) cruise — one of the most romantic budget experiences available. Shared group sunset cruises cost MVR 200–350 per person and offer stunning views of the sunset over the Indian Ocean from the water.

meals.breakfast: Energizing breakfast before kayaking — eggs, toast, banana, and juice for MVR 60–90
meals.lunch: Local café lunch — tuna sandwich and fresh coconut water for MVR 50–80
meals.dinner: Splurge on a slightly nicer dinner to celebrate a wonderful week — mixed seafood grill at a beachside restaurant for MVR 200–280 per person

day_by_day.notes: Kayaking is excellent for exploring areas inaccessible by foot and offers a unique perspective of the lagoon. Apply waterproof sunscreen as UV exposure is intense on the water. The sunset dhoni cruise is one of the most romantic and memorable budget experiences in the Maldives — highly recommended for honeymooners.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed morning at the resort — sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and spend time on the beachfront. This is a designated rest day to recharge for the final days of the trip. Enjoy a morning swim in the lagoon and read a book under a palm tree.
day_by_day.afternoon: DIY spa afternoon — purchase local coconut oil and natural ingredients from the market and give each other relaxing massages on the beach or in your room. Alternatively, visit a local spa for a budget couples' treatment (MVR 400–600 for both).
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach dinner setup — purchase fresh food from the local market, prepare simple dishes, and set up a candlelit dinner on the beach. Use fairy lights, flowers, and candles purchased locally to create a magical atmosphere without the resort price tag.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent resort breakfast — treat yourselves to the resort's breakfast spread if available for MVR 150–200 per person
meals.lunch: Light beach snack — fresh tropical fruit platter and coconut water for MVR 50–80
meals.dinner: DIY romantic beach dinner — freshly prepared local ingredients, sparkling juice, and local desserts for MVR 200–300 total for two

day_by_day.notes: A rest day is essential on a 13-day trip to avoid burnout and fully appreciate the surroundings. The DIY romantic dinner is one of the most memorable budget honeymoon experiences — put effort into the setup and it will rival any resort experience. Purchase fresh tropical fruits like mango, papaya, and watermelon from the local market.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling excursion — book a group snorkeling trip to the best reef in the area as recommended by local dive operators. This should be a bucket-list snorkeling experience to cap off your underwater adventures. Look for whale sharks if the season permits.
day_by_day.afternoon: Shopping for local souvenirs and gifts at the local market — purchase handmade lacquerware, woven mats, local spices, and Maldivian handicrafts. Support local artisans and bring home authentic memories. Budget MVR 200–500 for souvenirs depending on preferences.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the best local restaurant you have discovered during your stay. Order your favorite Maldivian dishes and reflect on the incredible experiences of the past 11 days. Toast to your honeymoon/romantic adventure with fresh tropical juice.

meals.breakfast: Classic Maldivian breakfast one last time — mas huni, roshi, and tea for MVR 50–80
meals.lunch: Quick local lunch between shopping — short eats and tea at a local café for MVR 40–60
meals.dinner: Best local restaurant farewell dinner — full Maldivian spread including garudhiya, mas riha, and bondibai for MVR 150–220 per person

day_by_day.notes: Bargaining is acceptable at souvenir markets but always be respectful. Avoid purchasing items made from coral, turtle shells, or other protected marine species. This is a great day to also get contact information from friendly locals you have met during your stay — Maldivians are wonderfully warm and hospitable people.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkeling session at the house reef — say goodbye to the underwater world that has been your playground for nearly two weeks. Take final underwater photos and videos to complete your memory collection.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack bags and prepare for departure the following day. Do a final walk around the local island, visit favorite spots one last time, and take final photos of the resort, beach, and surroundings. Exchange contact details with resort staff and fellow travelers.
day_by_day.evening: Final sunset at the Maldives — find the best vantage point on the beach and watch the sun dip below the Indian Ocean horizon one last time. Reflect on the incredible memories made during this budget honeymoon adventure in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Local café breakfast — favorite breakfast dishes one last time for MVR 50–80
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort or local restaurant — fish sandwich and juice for MVR 70–100
meals.dinner: Special final night dinner — treat yourselves to a slightly splurged meal at the nicest affordable restaurant found during the trip for MVR 250–350 per person

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing early to avoid last-minute stress. Keep travel documents, passports, and boarding passes easily accessible. Confirm your departure transfer to the airport — book in advance for the best budget rate. Consider a public ferry to Malé followed by the airport ferry as the most budget-friendly airport transfer option.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Maldives — wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach. Take a final swim in the warm Indian Ocean waters. Complete packing and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrange transfer to the airport — allow plenty of time for the journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport with sufficient time before departure. Complete check-in and security procedures. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts — local Maldivian honey, spices, and handicrafts make excellent purchases. Reflect on 13 incredible days in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with hearts full of wonderful memories. The budget honeymoon in the Maldives has proven that paradise does not require an unlimited budget — just creativity, local knowledge, and the right company.

meals.breakfast: Final resort or local café breakfast — make it special with your favorite Maldivian dishes for MVR 60–100
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — international options available at the airport for MVR 100–200
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 12:00 noon — confirm with the resort. The airport transfer should be booked at least 24 hours in advance. Keep some MVR for any last-minute expenses at the airport. Declare any food items at customs when returning home. Congratulations on completing your budget Maldives honeymoon — a truly unforgettable adventure!

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight in transit (LH arrives at 13:00)
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in, receive a welcome drink, and settle into your Beachfront villa. Take a leisurely stroll along the beach to familiarize yourself with the resort grounds.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from your villa's private deck or the resort beach. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's main beachfront restaurant to ease into island time.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at Malé airport during transit
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront restaurant – try fresh grilled fish and local coconut curry (mid-range set menu, approx. $40–$60 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light and relaxed – jet lag and travel fatigue are common. Confirm all pre-booked experiences with the resort concierge upon check-in. Request a honeymoon/romance setup (rose petals, fruit platter) if arranged in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Afterward, head to the resort's house reef for a guided snorkeling orientation session. Explore the colorful coral gardens, spot reef fish, and get comfortable with the crystal-clear lagoon waters right off your beachfront villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef – Join a guided snorkeling excursion to Banana Reef, one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites. Marvel at vibrant parrotfish, moray eels, sea turtles, and intricate coral formations. The boat ride itself offers stunning open-ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne – Set sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat as the golden sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Sip chilled champagne with your partner, enjoy canapés, and soak in the romantic ambiance of the open sea.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant – fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs to order (included or ~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's poolside café – sandwiches, salads, fresh juices (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's overwater or beachside restaurant – grilled seafood platter with a bottle of wine (~$50–$70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a rash guard, and an underwater camera for Banana Reef. The Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours – book through the resort concierge the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a romantic breakfast delivered to your villa's private deck (in-room dining). Spend the morning lounging on your beachfront, swimming in the lagoon, or reading in a hammock under the palm trees.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two – Indulge in a luxurious couples' spa session in the resort's glass-walled underwater treatment room. Watch rays and tropical fish glide past while receiving massages and beauty treatments. A truly unforgettable honeymoon experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy cocktails at the resort's sunset bar, then head to the resort's fine dining restaurant for a romantic à la carte dinner. Request a private candlelit table on the beach if available.

meals.breakfast: In-villa private breakfast with tropical fruits, fresh pastries, and coffee (~$30–$40 per person or included in package)
meals.lunch: Light bites at the spa café post-treatment – smoothies, wraps, and fresh juices (~$15–$25 per person)
meals.dinner: À la carte romantic dinner at the resort's signature restaurant – lobster thermidor or tuna tartare starter, mains of your choice, dessert (~$60–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment well in advance as slots fill quickly, especially for couples. Arrive 15 minutes early to enjoy the spa's relaxation lounge and herbal teas.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling at the resort's house reef during high tide – the best time to spot nurse sharks and eagle rays resting near the coral. Have a hearty breakfast afterward at the main restaurant.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class – Take a speedboat to the nearby inhabited island of Maafushi or Hulhumalé. Explore local streets, visit a traditional mosque, browse artisan workshops, and learn about Maldivian history. Participate in a hands-on cooking class to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish broth), and roshi (flatbread).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a casual evening at the resort's beach bar – try local-inspired cocktails like the 'Maldivian Sunset' (rum, passion fruit, coconut). Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean from a beach lounger.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort – eggs, fresh fruits, cereals, local breads (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you prepared during the cooking class on the cultural island tour (typically included in the tour)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beach bar & grill – grilled barracuda, fish tacos, coconut rice (~$30–$45 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for the cultural island visit (cover shoulders and knees out of respect). Bring cash (USD or MVR) for local souvenir shopping. The cooking class is a wonderful way to bring a piece of Maldives home with you.

day_by_day.morning: Join the resort's guided dolphin-watching boat excursion in the early morning – spinner dolphins are frequently spotted frolicking in the waters around the atolls. Return for a mid-morning breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a free afternoon at the resort – use the infinity pool, try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or kayaking in the calm lagoon, or simply relax on your beachfront with a good book and a tropical drink delivered by beach service.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience – Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. Enjoy a beautifully curated private dinner under the stars with candles, fresh seafood, chilled wine, and the sound of gentle waves – just the two of you.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the main restaurant post-dolphin excursion – omelets, fresh juices, pastries (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch – burgers, salads, fresh coconut water (~$25–$35 per person)
meals.dinner: Private Sandbank Picnic Dinner (typically a curated 3-course meal included in the experience package – approx. $120–$180 per couple, all-inclusive)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience must be booked at least 2–3 days in advance through the resort concierge. Bring a light wrap or shawl for the open-air sandbank as it can get breezy after sunset. This is one of the most romantic experiences of the trip – perfect for a honeymoon highlight.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning yoga or meditation class on the beach or resort deck (many Maldivian resorts offer complimentary or low-cost sessions). Follow with a nourishing breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling expedition to a second nearby reef site recommended by the resort's marine biologist or dive center – look for whale sharks if in season (March is a good month). Alternatively, try an introductory scuba diving lesson in the resort's pool followed by a shallow reef dive.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic couples' massage at the resort spa (above-water treatment room) as the sun sets. Afterward, dine at the resort's overwater restaurant with views of the moonlit lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast at the resort – acai bowls, granola, fresh tropical fruit platter (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Light snack from the dive/snorkel boat – sandwiches, fruit, water (included in excursion or ~$10–$15 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort – seared yellowfin tuna, prawn curry, local desserts (~$50–$70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: March is generally excellent for whale shark sightings around South Ari Atoll – ask the resort's dive center for the latest sightings. Book the couples' massage at least a day in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest day – sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed or on your villa deck. Spend the morning exploring the resort's gardens, taking photos, and writing postcards or journaling your honeymoon memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a resort-organized glass-bottom boat tour over the house reef – perfect for those who want to observe marine life without getting wet. Spot corals, sea turtles, and colorful fish from the comfort of the boat.
day_by_day.evening: Second Sunset Dhoni Cruise or a private bonfire on the beach arranged by the resort (check availability). End the evening with dessert and cocktails at the resort's lounge bar.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast or main restaurant – full cooked breakfast with Maldivian mas huni and roshi (~$20–$35 per person)
meals.lunch: Resort café – fresh fish wraps, tropical smoothies, coconut pudding (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Resort lounge restaurant – tapas-style sharing plates, cheese board, local fish ceviche, wine (~$40–$55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is intentionally relaxed as a midpoint reset. Use the afternoon to reconfirm any remaining bookings for the second half of the trip with the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing trip with local Maldivian fishermen – try traditional hand-line fishing in the open ocean. A fun and authentic cultural activity. Catch of the day can sometimes be prepared by the resort chef for your lunch.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and have your catch cooked by the resort's chef (if permitted). Spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with a cocktail in hand, or explore the resort's boutique for local crafts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef (second visit) – revisit this stunning reef at a different time of day (late afternoon) for a completely different marine experience, including different fish species active at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before fishing – fresh fruit, yogurt, coffee (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.lunch: Your catch prepared by the resort chef – grilled fish with salad and rice (complimentary or small prep fee of ~$20–$30)
meals.dinner: Resort beachfront restaurant – romantic dinner for two with lobster or reef fish, local desserts, wine (~$55–$75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm the fishing trip timing with the concierge – most depart at 6:00–7:00 AM. Bring sunscreen and a hat for the open-ocean fishing excursion. The late-afternoon snorkel at Banana Reef offers beautiful light for underwater photography.

day_by_day.morning: Relax with a slow morning – swim in the lagoon, collect shells along the beach, and enjoy a peaceful breakfast. Visit the resort's water sports center to try windsurfing or kiteboarding (lessons available for beginners).
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two (second session or alternative treatment) – If you loved Day 3's spa experience, book a different treatment such as a hot stone massage, aromatherapy wrap, or a Maldivian coconut scrub for two.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (if not done on Day 2, or as a repeat romantic experience) – alternatively, enjoy a private candlelit dinner on your villa's deck arranged by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort – full spread of local and international options (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Beach shack-style lunch at the resort's casual eatery – fish and chips, coleslaw, fresh lemonade (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Private in-villa candlelit dinner arranged by resort – curated 3-course menu with wine (~$80–$120 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The in-villa private dinner is a beautiful alternative to restaurant dining and adds an extra layer of romance. Arrange this at least 24 hours in advance with the concierge and specify any dietary preferences.

day_by_day.morning: Join the resort's marine biologist for a reef conservation snorkeling session – learn about coral restoration efforts, identify reef species, and even plant a coral fragment as a symbolic act of giving back to the ocean (a memorable honeymoon keepsake).
day_by_day.afternoon: Free afternoon for leisure – rent a bicycle and explore the resort island, visit the resort's library or reading nook, or simply nap in a hammock between the palms. Enjoy afternoon tea at the resort's terrace.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class (if not done on Day 4, or visit a different island). Alternatively, attend a traditional Bodu Beru drumming performance at the resort or a nearby island – an energetic and culturally rich evening experience.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the reef session – smoothie bowl, toast, fresh juice (~$15–$25 per person)
meals.lunch: Resort café – pasta salad, grilled vegetables, iced tea (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Resort main restaurant – Maldivian-themed dinner night (if available) with local curries, roshi, fresh fish, and traditional sweets (~$40–$55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The coral planting activity is increasingly offered by eco-conscious Maldivian resorts and is a unique, meaningful experience. Ask the concierge if Aegean Bliss Resort offers this program.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise kayaking or paddleboarding in the calm lagoon – magical at dawn when the water is glassy and the sky turns pink and gold. Return for a hearty breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience (second visit or alternative sandbank) – if you loved Day 5's experience, ask the resort if there's a different sandbank location for a fresh perspective. Alternatively, take a scenic speedboat tour around nearby uninhabited islands.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a couple's sunset cocktail hour at the beach bar. Head to the overwater restaurant for a final fine-dining experience at the resort's most premium venue.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast – full spread including local Maldivian dishes (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic lunch (included in experience) or speedboat island tour with packed lunch (~$25–$40 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater fine dining restaurant – tasting menu or à la carte with wine pairing (~$70–$90 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is a great day to splurge slightly on the fine-dining experience as a pre-farewell celebration. Consider purchasing a bottle of Maldivian-themed wine or a local craft as a souvenir.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session at the house reef – say goodbye to the turtles, rays, and reef fish you've come to recognize over the past week. Collect any underwater photos from the resort's photography service if booked.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon packing, visiting the resort's boutique for last-minute souvenirs (lacquerware, woven mats, local spices, jewelry), and relaxing at the pool. Enjoy a final spa treatment or foot massage to unwind.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort – choose your favorite restaurant from the trip for a nostalgic final meal. Toast to your honeymoon with a bottle of champagne and reflect on your 13-day Maldivian adventure.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast – enjoy the full spread one last time (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch – light and easy, salads, wraps, fresh juices (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at your favorite resort restaurant – splurge on a special bottle of wine or champagne (~$60–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort to prepare a farewell gift or honeymoon certificate as a keepsake. Confirm your checkout time and transfer arrangements for Day 13 with the front desk.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one last sunrise on your beachfront. Take a final walk along the shoreline, dip your feet in the lagoon, and soak in the beauty of the Maldives one last time. Enjoy a leisurely final breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout is 12:00 noon – request a late checkout if your transfer allows). Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane back to Malé International Airport. Depart the Maldives with hearts full of memories.
day_by_day.evening: In transit / departure flight

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at the resort – make it special with fresh tropical fruits, local pastries, and a freshly brewed coffee (~$20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Light meal at Malé airport or on the departure flight
meals.dinner: On the flight

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2–3 hours before your flight for the resort transfer, airport check-in, and immigration. Store any fragile souvenirs (lacquerware, coral jewelry) in your carry-on. Carry a copy of all resort receipts and travel documents for customs if needed.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat with your partner as the sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and uninterrupted panoramic views of the sky turning shades of gold and pink. Many resorts offer this as a private excursion, making it an iconic romantic honeymoon memory.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most famous and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, sea turtles, and colorful soft corals. Banana Reef is ideal for snorkelers of all levels and offers crystal-clear visibility up to 30 meters. Guided snorkel tours ensure you spot the best marine life while learning about reef conservation.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa session at a glass-walled underwater treatment room, where you can watch reef fish glide past while receiving traditional Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local botanicals. This ultra-luxurious experience blends wellness with the magic of the ocean, perfect for honeymooners seeking something truly extraordinary.
experiences.location: Huvafen Fushi Resort, North Malé Atoll

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon, where a personal chef sets up a gourmet candlelit lunch or dinner just for two. Feast on freshly grilled lobster, sashimi-grade tuna, and tropical desserts while surrounded by nothing but ocean and sky — the ultimate luxury romantic dining experience.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited island of Maafushi or Hulhumalé to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, browse handmade lacquerwork crafts, and join a hands-on cooking class to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and garudhiya fish soup. A meaningful cultural contrast to resort luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrival at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler at the private terminal for a seamless VIP transfer via luxury seaplane or private speedboat to the resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional Maldivian welcome with chilled towels, fresh coconut water, and a garland greeting. Private resort orientation tour and overwater villa check-in with personalized amenity setup.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into your Beachfront Villa. Enjoy a private welcome dinner on your villa deck — a curated four-course meal prepared by your personal chef, served under the stars with the sound of gentle waves. Complimentary welcome bottle of Moët & Chandon Champagne arranged by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight)
meals.lunch: Light refreshments and canapés served during private transfer and welcome experience at the resort
meals.dinner: Private in-villa four-course welcome dinner on your beachfront deck — freshly caught Maldivian lobster, seared tuna tataki, tropical fruit sorbet, and a curated wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all arrival documents, resort confirmation, and seaplane/speedboat transfer booking are confirmed in advance. Luggage is handled entirely by the resort butler. Request any dietary preferences or special romantic touches (rose petals, custom welcome board) ahead of arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely start with a private in-villa breakfast served on your deck overlooking the lagoon. Afterward, enjoy a guided snorkeling session at the resort's house reef — your personal marine biologist guide will introduce you to the vibrant coral gardens, reef sharks, and sea turtles right off your beachfront villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's overwater spa for a relaxing couples' massage — the 'Ocean Harmony' ritual using Maldivian coconut oil and sea salt scrub. Spend the remaining afternoon lounging at your private plunge pool or the adults-only infinity pool with panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat as the golden sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon. Sip chilled Champagne and indulge in a gourmet canapé selection while your captain narrates the magic of the Maldivian seascape.

meals.breakfast: Private in-villa breakfast: freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit platter, eggs Benedict, freshly squeezed juices, and barista coffee
meals.lunch: Casual poolside dining at the resort's Aqua Lounge — grilled reef fish tacos, watermelon and feta salad, and chilled coconut mocktails
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's signature overwater fine-dining restaurant 'Coral & Salt' — seven-course tasting menu featuring Maldivian bluefin tuna, langoustine bisque, and a decadent dark chocolate fondant with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Book the Sunset Dhoni Cruise at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. Best snorkeling visibility is typically in the morning. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — the resort provides complimentary eco-friendly SPF products.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef — one of the Maldives' most iconic and biodiverse coral reefs. A private resort speedboat transfers you to this legendary site where you'll encounter parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and vibrant coral formations. A certified dive master accompanies you for safety and narration.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a gourmet beachside lunch. Spend the afternoon on a private sandbank excursion — your butler arranges a short speedboat ride to a secluded white sandbank where you can swim, sunbathe, and enjoy absolute seclusion in the middle of the turquoise Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Candlelit dinner on the beach — the resort's beach dining experience features a dedicated chef, personalized menu, and a table set romantically on the sand with lanterns and tropical flower arrangements. Ideal for honeymoon couples.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant 'The Pearl' — live cooking stations, fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut), and an extensive pastry selection
meals.lunch: Beachside grilled seafood platter with lobster, tiger prawns, and calamari — served with chilled rosé wine at the resort's Shoreline Grill
meals.dinner: Private beach candlelit dinner — five-course personalized menu with your choice of lobster thermidor, wagyu beef tenderloin, or pan-seared sea bass, paired with a curated wine selection

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef requires a 20–30 minute speedboat ride from most North Malé Atoll resorts. Confirm exact transfer time with your butler. Bring an underwater camera or ask the resort to arrange a professional underwater photographer for the snorkeling excursion.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga session on a private overwater platform at sunrise — the resort's resident yoga instructor leads a 60-minute couples' session with breathtaking ocean panoramas. Follow with a refreshing swim in the lagoon directly from your villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — the resort's crown jewel experience. Indulge in a 90-minute couples' spa ritual in a glass-walled underwater treatment room. Watch manta rays and tropical fish glide past as skilled therapists perform a deep tissue and aromatherapy massage. Truly unforgettable.
day_by_day.evening: Cocktail hour at the resort's Sky Bar — perched above the lagoon with 360-degree sunset views. Enjoy handcrafted signature cocktails before heading to dinner.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-yoga snack provided by the resort (smoothie bowl, banana, and herbal tea). Full breakfast after yoga at 'The Pearl' — avocado toast, smoked salmon, and freshly brewed specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Japanese-inspired lunch at the resort's Omakase counter — sashimi selection, miso soup, edamame, and matcha ice cream
meals.dinner: Dinner at 'Indigo' — the resort's Mediterranean-inspired restaurant with an open kitchen. Enjoy burrata with heirloom tomatoes, grilled branzino with lemon caper butter, and tiramisu with amaretto

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa is the resort's most sought-after experience — book at least 3–4 days in advance through your butler. The yoga session is best enjoyed at 6:30 AM when the ocean is calmest and the sunrise most dramatic.

day_by_day.morning: Guided dolphin watching cruise — depart early morning on a luxury catamaran to spot spinner dolphins in their natural habitat in the open ocean. Snorkeling opportunity at a pristine outer reef site on the return journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. A private chef prepares a gourmet picnic spread: chilled seafood, artisan cheeses, tropical fruits, and chilled Champagne. Swim, sunbathe, and enjoy complete seclusion.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing experience on the resort's private observatory deck — a resident astronomer guides you through the southern hemisphere's constellation map. The Maldives' remote location ensures virtually zero light pollution for extraordinary star visibility.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: freshly made waffles with berry compote, smoked salmon bagels, tropical juices, and a Nespresso coffee selection
meals.lunch: Gourmet sandbank picnic — lobster rolls, charcuterie board, fresh tropical fruit, macarons, and chilled Moët & Chandon Rosé Champagne
meals.dinner: Dinner at 'The Pearl' main restaurant — Maldivian-inspired tasting menu featuring reef fish curry, coconut-infused rice, and fresh mango pudding with a curated cocktail pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Sandbank Picnic is weather-dependent — confirm with your butler the morning of the experience. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and a light cover-up as sandbanks offer minimal shade. The stargazing session begins at approximately 8:30 PM when the sky is fully dark.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — a private speedboat takes you to a nearby inhabited island (Maafushi or Hulhumalé) for an immersive cultural experience. Explore a traditional Maldivian village, visit a local mosque, and browse artisan craft workshops. Learn the art of traditional Bodu Beru drumming.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cooking class with a local Maldivian family — learn to prepare authentic dishes including garudhiya (tuna broth), mas riha (fish curry), and hedhikaa (traditional snacks). Enjoy your handcrafted meal together as a shared cultural celebration.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Enjoy cocktails at your private villa deck, followed by a romantic in-villa movie night with a curated snack platter and your choice of fine wine — arranged by your butler on a projector screen facing the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at 'The Pearl' — extensive spread including Maldivian mas huni, fresh roti, tropical fruits, and live egg station
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian home-cooked meal as part of the cooking class — garudhiya, mas riha, fresh coconut sambol, and sweet bondi (coconut pancakes)
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining — chef-prepared Japanese wagyu ribeye, truffle mashed potatoes, roasted asparagus, and a chocolate and raspberry tart with a bottle of Château Margaux

day_by_day.notes: The cultural tour is a wonderful way to connect with the authentic Maldivian way of life beyond the resort. Dress modestly when visiting the island (shoulders and knees covered out of respect). Your butler will arrange all transfers and local guide coordination.

day_by_day.morning: Full morning of leisure — sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and spend time at your private plunge pool. Optional: take out a complimentary kayak or stand-up paddleboard from the resort's water sports center and explore the calm lagoon at your own pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Couples' rejuvenation afternoon at the resort spa — begin with a hydrotherapy circuit (steam room, ice plunge, and Jacuzzi), followed by a 60-minute Maldivian Frangipani Ritual body wrap and facial for two. End with herbal tea in the spa garden.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset Dhoni Cruise (second experience, different route) — this time the dhoni sails toward a bioluminescent bay. After sunset, witness the magical blue glow of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the ocean at night — a truly ethereal and rare experience.

meals.breakfast: Slow in-villa breakfast delivered in a beautifully presented basket — fresh pastries, tropical fruit bowl, Greek yogurt with honey, and specialty pour-over coffee
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch at the wellness café — chilled gazpacho, quinoa and roasted vegetable bowl, fresh pressed juices, and raw chocolate bliss balls
meals.dinner: Dinner at 'Coral & Salt' overwater restaurant — à la carte premium selection including Maldivian spiny lobster bisque, pan-seared duck breast with passion fruit jus, and a decadent crème brûlée

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescence is most visible on darker nights (avoid full moon periods if possible). The phenomenon is caused by Noctiluca scintillans plankton and is completely natural. Your butler will advise on the best evening based on conditions during your stay.

day_by_day.morning: Private snorkeling safari — your dedicated marine guide takes you by speedboat to three different pristine snorkeling spots around the atoll, each with unique marine life. Highlights include a turtle cleaning station, a nurse shark resting area, and a vibrant hard coral garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely afternoon. Enjoy a private mixology class with the resort's head bartender — learn to craft three signature Maldivian-inspired cocktails using local ingredients like pandan, coconut, and fresh tropical fruits.
day_by_day.evening: Overwater dinner experience — the resort sets up a private table on a floating platform in the middle of the lagoon, accessible by a short canoe ride. Dine under a canopy of stars with lanterns reflecting on the glassy water below.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at 'The Pearl' — fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian breakfast spread, live cooking stations, and fresh juices
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling light lunch at the Shoreline Grill — grilled barracuda with mango salsa, coconut rice, and chilled sparkling water
meals.dinner: Floating overwater private dinner — five-course menu: amuse-bouche, seared scallops, champagne sorbet, grilled Maldivian reef fish with saffron beurre blanc, and a trio of petit fours with dessert wine

day_by_day.notes: The snorkeling safari is one of the most comprehensive marine experiences available — request an underwater camera rental from the resort to document the highlights. The floating dinner platform is limited to one couple per evening, so book early through your butler.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise fishing experience — join the resort's traditional Maldivian fishing crew for a line-fishing session at dawn in the traditional Maldivian style (no reels, just handlines). A serene and authentic way to experience the ocean at first light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Your morning's catch is prepared by the resort's executive chef in a personalized 'catch-to-table' lunch experience. Spend the afternoon at leisure — explore the resort's boutique, enjoy a hammock session over the lagoon, or take a nap in your private villa.
day_by_day.evening: Couples' cooking class with the resort's executive chef — learn to prepare a three-course Maldivian-French fusion meal in the resort's private kitchen, then enjoy your creation together with wine pairings.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing snack: banana, energy bar, and thermos of coffee provided on the fishing boat. Full breakfast on return at 'The Pearl'
meals.lunch: Catch-to-table experience — your morning's fresh catch prepared three ways: ceviche, grilled with herb butter, and a light fish curry. Served with tropical sides and chilled white wine
meals.dinner: Your own creation from the cooking class — enjoyed in the resort's private dining room with curated wine pairings selected by the sommelier

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise fishing experience departs at approximately 5:30 AM — an early start, but the calm ocean and dramatic sunrise make it absolutely worthwhile. All fishing equipment is provided. The catch-to-table experience is subject to what is caught — the chef will advise on the best preparation.

day_by_day.morning: Full spa morning — begin with a private outdoor yoga and meditation session on the beach at sunrise, followed by a 90-minute 'Maldivian Journey' full-body treatment combining hot stone therapy, coconut scrub, and a traditional Maldivian herbal compress massage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private island hopping by luxury speedboat — visit two uninhabited islands nearby. Snorkel, collect shells, and explore untouched white sand beaches that few visitors ever reach. The resort packs a private picnic hamper for the journey.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa anniversary/honeymoon setup arranged by the butler — rose petal turndown, floating candles in the plunge pool, a personalized photo book of your trip highlights (if pre-arranged), and a bottle of Dom Pérignon on ice.

meals.breakfast: Healthy wellness breakfast at the spa café — açaí bowl, chia pudding, fresh coconut water, green smoothie, and gluten-free banana bread
meals.lunch: Private island picnic hamper — artisan sandwiches, charcuterie, fresh tropical fruits, macarons, and chilled Champagne
meals.dinner: In-villa romantic dinner — lobster bisque, beef tenderloin with truffle jus, and a custom honeymoon cake prepared by the pastry chef

day_by_day.notes: If celebrating a honeymoon or anniversary, inform the resort team at booking so they can prepare personalized touches throughout the stay. The plunge pool candlelight setup is best enjoyed after 7:30 PM when the sky is fully dark.

day_by_day.morning: Freediving introductory session with a certified instructor — learn the basics of breath-hold diving in the resort's calm lagoon. A unique way to experience the underwater world more intimately than traditional snorkeling, gliding silently through the reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure afternoon — spend time at the resort's adults-only infinity pool with a curated playlist and personalized poolside service. Enjoy chilled tropical cocktails, fresh fruit platters, and cold towel service delivered to your sun lounger.
day_by_day.evening: Final grand dining experience at 'Coral & Salt' — the resort's most prestigious seven-course chef's table experience, hosted by the executive chef who personally presents and narrates each dish. A true gastronomic celebration.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: eggs royale with smoked salmon, freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit, and freshly brewed specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside light bites — lobster sliders, truffle fries, watermelon and mint salad, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Seven-course chef's table dinner at 'Coral & Salt' — featuring the finest local and imported ingredients: Maldivian caviar, bluefin tuna tartare, Wagyu beef, and a signature chocolate sphere dessert with warm praline sauce

day_by_day.notes: Freediving is suitable for non-swimmers who are comfortable in water — the instructor will assess your comfort level before proceeding. No prior experience is necessary. The chef's table experience accommodates a maximum of four guests per evening, making it an intimate and exclusive affair.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling excursion — revisit your favorite reef site from the trip for one last swim with the turtles and reef sharks. Collect a few final underwater photographs with the resort's professional underwater photographer who accompanies you.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely afternoon dedicated to relaxation and last-minute indulgences — a final visit to the spa for a 45-minute express facial, followed by packing assistance from your butler. Browse the resort boutique for curated Maldivian souvenirs and artisan gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort's beach restaurant — a relaxed yet elegant meal celebrating the end of a perfect Maldivian journey. Request a personalized menu card as a keepsake from the chef.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at 'The Pearl' — a final celebration of the resort's extensive breakfast spread, including your favorite dishes from the past 12 days
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the Aqua Lounge — sushi selection, miso soup, and a refreshing yuzu sorbet
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the beach restaurant — grilled whole Maldivian snapper, coconut prawn curry, fresh roti, and a celebratory dessert platter with a personalized 'Thank You' message from the chef

day_by_day.notes: Request your professional underwater photography package from the resort — images from all excursions can be compiled into a digital album or printed photo book as a lasting memento. Confirm departure transfer arrangements with your butler this evening for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early for one last barefoot walk along the white sand shoreline. Watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean from your private villa deck with a final cup of specialty coffee. A quiet, reflective moment to close a perfect journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Checkout and departure — your butler manages all luggage and transfer arrangements. A private speedboat or seaplane transfer returns you to Malé International Airport with VIP lounge access arranged by the resort. Depart with memories of an extraordinary Maldivian escape.
day_by_day.evening: Departure flight — in-flight or at destination

meals.breakfast: Early departure breakfast packed by the resort — a gourmet travel hamper with freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit, artisan sandwiches, and a thermos of specialty coffee for the journey
meals.lunch: At Malé Airport VIP lounge or in-flight
meals.dinner: In-flight or at destination

day_by_day.notes: Seaplane transfers from most Maldivian resorts must be completed before sunset — confirm your exact departure time with the resort well in advance. Ensure all resort charges, gratuities for your butler and staff, and souvenir purchases are settled the evening prior to avoid a rushed checkout. Keep your underwater photos, personalized menus, and keepsakes safely packed in your carry-on luggage.
